{{Top|leg}}
A '''Polarizing field generator''' was a large piece of equipment that allowed the use of electronic equipment within an area around the generator in harsh [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]], such as the atmosphere of [[Krykas V]]. [[Min Erethen]], a scientist working for [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] equipped various [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and her workshop, the [[Sanctum Sanctorum]] with polarizing field generators while she was stranded on Krykas V.

The polarizing field generators on the Sanctum Sanctorum had a effective radius of fifty meters.
